Organize your clients and deals in your browser: a drag-and-drop Kanban board, a unified log for activities, notes, and tasks, customizable views, and local file export and import with no server.
Deal Hub — Kanban board and unified log for managing deals

Quick answer: You can manage all your prospects and deals from this page alone, right in your browser, with no server, account, or network connection, because the data stays in memory during your session and can be exported and imported as a local file at any time. Start by adding your first deal with the «Add deal» button, then drag and drop its card between Kanban stages to track its progress step by step. Log every call, message, note, and task in the unified log, mark completed tasks, and use custom views to filter and sort deals and choose the columns that matter to you. Everything works instantly with no setup or extra steps.
Do you need an account or an internet connection to use Deal Hub?
No. The app runs entirely in your browser, your data stays in memory only during the session, and you can export and import it as a local file whenever you want.
How do I move a deal between Kanban stages?
Drag the deal card and drop it into the desired column, and the move is logged automatically in the unified log with the new stage name.
What's the difference between the unified log and custom views?
The unified log collects activities, comments, notes, and tasks for all deals, while custom views let you filter and sort deals and choose which columns appear.
Is my data saved after I close the page?
It isn't saved automatically; click «Export JSON file» before closing, then use «Import file» to restore it in a later session.
